pages.title: A table that remembers
text: The Tribal Bench is a crafting table two blocks wide, with a shelf along the back, and it comes in every wood so it matches the camp it stands in.
The difference that matters: **the grid belongs to the bench**. Close it halfway through a recipe and everything stays where you left it, instead of spilling back into your pack.

pages.title: With JEI
text: If you run JEI, the bench is a full crafting station: open a crafting recipe and press **+** (or JEI's move-recipe keys) to pull the ingredients from your inventory into the grid. Clicking the arrow in the bench shows every crafting recipe.
